description: The Argentine energy ministry provides a national hydrocarbon-transport page linking an interactive map, open data and a pipeline-capacity summary. These links define an official access route to transport-system information. The provider is Secretaría de Energía. Coverage: Coverage is Argentina. The brief landing page does not state capacity units, reference year, data resolution or the number of represented pipelines. Access: The official page links public data and a capacity-summary PDF. Neither the map payload nor the capacity document was downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The capacity values and their reference dates were not inspected. The landing page alone does not support a numerical network model. For simulation it is a source route for pipeline-capacity inputs, subject to checking the linked summary and its currency. Related resources: The existing ENARGAS pipeline and Resolution 319/93 duct records cover network geometry. Neither explicitly identifies this national capacity summary.
